guesses.reason: Broad bear-like head, small deep-set brown eyes, thick erect triangular ears, dense double coat, and a fluffy tail curled over the back in a black-and-white pinto pattern are all classic American Akita traits.

guesses.breed: Akita mix (possibly with Siberian Husky or Alaskan Malamute)
guesses.reason: The large, slightly rounded ears and somewhat narrower muzzle could hint at another spitz-type contribution.
Prick ears and curled plume tail are shared spitz features, though the size and heavy build favor Akita.

breed.appearance: A large, sturdy, double-coated dog with a pinto pattern: a mostly black head with a narrow white blaze between the eyes, a black muzzle with graying and white whiskers, and a white chest, legs, and paws. His thick, upright triangular ears are black, his small almond-shaped eyes are warm brown, and his body shows big black patches over a white base. A fluffy cream-white tail curls up over his back like a plume.
breed.fun_fact: Akitas are famously loyal—the legendary Hachiko waited for his person at a train station every day for nearly ten years!
